punchline: A hotel note that added the words 'guests of this room' lifted towel reuse from 37.2 to 49.3 percent.
thirty_sec: In a hotel study cited in the book Yes!, a standard environmental message got 37.2 percent towel reuse. Messages saying about 75 percent of a group reused towels got 42.8 percent, and the one naming guests of the same room got 49.3. The towel and the figure were identical. What changed was the group. Goldstein, Martin and Cialdini draw the lesson: name the group closest to your listener.
